description: Change fields of an SAP business partner (`fields`, A_BusinessPartner) and/or of its standard address (`address_fields`, A_BusinessPartnerAddress). Reads first and sends the version (ETag) along, so it fails instead of overwriting a change made in SAP meanwhile; header and address go as ONE changeset (both or neither). Afterwards checks that SAP really stored every field. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

address_fields.description: A_BusinessPartnerAddress fields for the standard address (API field name -> value)

business_partner.description: SAP business partner number to change

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's SAP connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: update_sap_business_partner
